desc: 石墨黑与冷雾灰配琥珀金，飞冰主图到双栏对比与空白配件收口
leaf: 台面手提子弹冰制冰机
name: 双档子弹冰自清洁台面制冰机款

shots.intent: 搜索列表里用开盖满篮弹冰与飞散冰粒一眼赢下点击
一秒交代全天随取随用的供冰能力，用俯视满冰与四杯阵列做主卖点
用左右同机位双栏对照承接与同类机的取舍对比，主张全部留白
把机器放进真实家庭厨房中岛聚会，让买家自我代入待客场景
让买家在两种冰型之间做选择，用仰拍浮冰与两张场景小卡给使用线索
用面板微距加三步图解讲清一键操作与取冰流程，灯位与字样全部留白
用四人碰杯与四枚空白图标位收束弹冰的社交与利益主张
用透视水路讲清内部循环清洁机制，替买家消除卫生顾虑
把使用半径从厨房扩到户外聚会，用黄昏长桌与暖灯串做代入
用俯拍随机配件与无数字外形引出线收口，消除体积与装箱疑虑

style.backgroundSystem: backgrounds cycle between a seamless brushed steel-white studio field #F2F4F6, a mist-grey board and cool concrete counter #C3CAD1 and a graphite-black stage #1B2129 used for the comparison board, the ice-format screen, the fascia macro and the dusk garden scene; the only accent is a sparse amber-gold marker #C98A3C; every information screen stays a flat matte graphic field with no gradient falloff and no photographic depth blur, and adjacent screens never repeat the same background tone
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line pictograms in graphite #1B2129 on light fields and in steel-white #F2F4F6 on dark fields, one pictogram per rounded chip, one amber-gold #C98A3C marker allowed per screen, never filled, never a seal, badge or certification mark
style.lightingSystem: cool 6000K soft key from the upper left with a broad right bounce fill, brushed shell reading as narrow vertical gradient bands instead of mirror smears, one skimming or sweeping pass reserved for ice and frost texture, short tight contact shadow directly under the base, one warm amber practical glow only inside the dusk garden scene, no coloured rim light and no blown specular hotspot
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent graphite premium countertop ice-appliance ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of brushed steel-white field #F2F4F6, cold mist-grey board and concrete counter #C3CAD1, graphite-black stage #1B2129 and one amber-gold accent #C98A3C; cool colour temperature throughout; cool 6000K soft key from the upper left with a broad right bounce fill, brushed steel reading as narrow vertical gradient bands rather than mirror smears, one skimming pass reserved for ice texture, short tight contact shadow under the base and no coloured rim light; backgrounds cycle between steel-white studio #F2F4F6, mist-grey board #C3CAD1 and graphite-black stage #1B2129 as flat matte information-screen fields with no gradient falloff and no photographic depth blur; one modern geometric sans-serif with a wide-tracked headline and placeholder-only wording; thin single-weight line pictograms in rounded chips, never a seal or badge; the appliance stays upright at one locked true scale on the same front axis with one lid hinge angle, and every indicator lamp, button face, display area, dimension leader, spec chip and caption rule stays blank with no glyph, no digit and no unit; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no rendered readouts, no invented figures.
noDrift: no colour palette changes and no glacier-blue, aqua-water, snow-white or crimson-wedge fields replacing the graphite, mist-grey, steel-white and amber system
no digits, units, readouts, cycle times, daily yield, cup counts or exterior dimensions drawn on any panel, leader line, chip or screen
no mixed fonts, no serif, no handwritten or cartoon lettering and no wordmark, store badge, star rating or promotional corner flag
no inconsistent key direction, no warm cast outside the dusk scene and no mismatched pictogram stroke weights between screens
no gradient falloff inside information screens, no plastic-looking opaque ice and no floating product without a contact shadow
style.presentationRules: the appliance stays upright at one locked true scale on the same front axis with the lid at one hinge angle and the same basket fill level across the set, never re-scaled and never clipped; every indicator lamp, button face, display area, dimension leader, spec chip and caption rule stays blank with no glyph, no digit and no unit; the scoop and the drink glasses are the only soft props and never cover the body
style.surfaceSystem: one cool concrete-grey kitchen counter #C3CAD1 and one seamless brushed steel-white sweep #F2F4F6 carry every indoor screen, the garden screen runs on weathered timber under a graphite-black dusk field #1B2129, and ice is always translucent frost-white with real internal fractures, never a welded block and never plastic-smooth
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif, one wide-tracked headline line over one short support line, all wording carried only by placeholders so any real campaign copy can drop in, hairline rules ending in one small solid dot; no English category word printed in frame and no readable body copy
